The cloud computing-related security issue described in the text is the lack of proper network access controls for data storage. Specifically, the e-commerce platform uses a public cloud but failed to configure restrictions on who can access its storage buckets. This oversight resulted in unrestricted access, allowing unauthorized entities to retrieve data, which led to data leaks. This highlights a critical vulnerability in data storage security where misconfigured permissions expose sensitive information to the public or malicious actors.
